name: ue-driver
summary: Shell commands to compile the project's C++, run editor Python unattended, and run the game unattended with its log checked for errors.
adapt: Add Saved/ to .gitignore if it is not there: logs go to Saved/Logs/gam3.
If the engine is not in the launcher's default location, set UE_ROOT to the engine root.

verified.how: Installed into a fresh C++ project. ue_build.mjs compiled it and refused while an editor had the project open. ue_game.mjs ran a built level under the blind, agent and human profiles and reported readiness, shots and log problems; --shots under blind was refused. slots.mjs: three runs started together with GAM3_MAX_ENGINES=2 queued and all finished. ue_python.mjs was run for 0.1.0 and not again. Windows and Linux were not run. 0.2.1: the agent profile was compared with full quality on a grass level, one setting at a time, by average colour; only settings within 2 in 255 were kept. The sleep-aware timeout was not exercised by an actual sleep. 0.2.2: game runs print notes before starting when the compiled module is older than the source (seen after touching a header), when the machine is busy with other work, or when a crash reporter is spinning; --ui passes -Gam3ShotUI. 0.2.3: look.mjs (blink, shimmer, compare). Run on bursts and stills from a real game's desktop build and its live web build: compare failed web against desktop on black level (+11 and +12) and passed desktop against desktop (0); blink and shimmer ran on ten-frame bursts and wrote heat pictures. Covered by a repository test with made-up pictures. The faults it is meant to catch were found by eye first; it has not yet caught one unprompted.
